full_judgment: 2. The short fact leading to this petition is that, one Anwar Rahim as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 3 of 1988 for setting aside the ex parte decree passed in title Suit No. 21 of 1968 by the learned Additional Munsif. Dhaka granting permanent injunction and restraining him from disturbing peaceful possession of the plaintiff of that suit by entering in Plot Nos. 329 and 331 of CS Khatian No. 128 of Mouza Bara Maghbazar, Dhaka. That suit was decreed on 19-5-1990 giving full relief to the plaintiff and against that defendant Abdus Sobhan preferred Title Appeal Nos. 214 of 1990 before the learned District Judge, Dhaka and the said appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, 4th Court, Dhaka who by his judgment and order dated 21-9-1997 allowed the appeal and set aside the ex parte decree passed in the aforesaid suit and sent back the suit on remand for fresh trial on certain observations made in the judgment. On being aggrieved by this order of remand respondent moved the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4197 of 1997 and a Single Bench of that Division on hearing the parties made the Rule absolute.
